say:2:1610507001:0.text: This one's quite simple: plain technique, just a small cottage. The title is "The Beginning", is that right?
say:2:1610507001:0.source_cn: 这幅画没什么特别之处，技巧很普通，题材也很直白，只是一...

say:4:1610507002:0.text: Yes, Your Highness. This is an original by Kronos von Lyceum himself—the very first headmaster who founded this academy. Legend says that very cottage is where he conceived the idea for the school.
say:4:1610507002:0.source_cn: 这是莱希拉姆魔法学校的创始人、首任校长莱希拉姆先生的亲...

say:5:1610507003:1.text: That explains the title. I see why it's precious to the Lyceum.
say:5:1610507003:1.source_cn: 怪不得起这样的名字呢……嗯，这幅画对你们来说确实有很高...
